content.text: The regressions pass, including strict nested-object recovery, flag precedence, lexical shadowing, exact uint64 arithmetic, nullable regex repetition, and randomized shortest-path comparisons. Direct isolated CLI runs also match both public fixtures. Scale probes completed for a 4,096-module shared-dependency DAG and a 4,095-command state preamble. I’m adding a few final end-to-end cases and cleaning generated caches from the submission tree.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/project/tests/test_campaign.py'
s=open(p).read()
pos=s.index('    def test_framing(self):')
s=s[:pos]+'''    def test_stateful_end_to_end_precedence_and_identity(self):
        types = [dict(name='State', kind='enum', values=['i','a','t','dead']),
                 dict(name='Msg', kind='string', maxsize=3),
                 dict(name='B', kind='bool')]
        c = campaign(types, [module('entry', [['s','State'],['m','Msg']], ['r','B'],
                                    ['not',['eq',['var','m'],['const','Msg','no']]])])
        c['machine'] = dict(states=['i','a','t','dead'], initial='i', state_param='s', message_param='m', transitions=[
            dict(**{'from':'i','to':'a'}, command='setup', cost=2, when=['eq',['var','s'],['const','State','t']]),
            dict(**{'from':'a','to':'t'}, command='finish', cost=3, when=None)])
        def witness(state, message, result):
            message = message.encode('latin-1')
            return dict(entry='entry',ktest=ktest([('x0',state.to_bytes(4,'little'))] +
                [(f'x{i+2}', bytes([message[i] if i < len(message) else 0])) for i in range(3)] + [('x5',bytes([result]))]))
        c['runs'] = [witness(2, 'a\\0x', 0), witness(2, 'a\\0y', 1), witness(3,'a',0),
                     witness(3,'no',0), witness(3,'no',2), witness(0,'',1)]
        answer = execute(c)
        self.assertEqual([r['status'] for r in answer['records']],
                         ['READY','DUPLICATE','UNREACHABLE','FILTERED','INVALID_TEST','READY'])
        self.assertEqual(answer['corpus'], [
            dict(entry='entry',inputs={'s':'t','m':'a'},cost=5,commands=['setup','finish','a'],witnesses=[0,1]),
            dict(entry='entry',inputs={'s':'i','m':''},cost=0,commands=[''],witnesses=[5])])

    def test_scoped_compilation_and_shared_types(self):
        types = [dict(name='I',kind='int',bits=1), dict(name='B',kind='bool'), dict(name='V',kind='void')]
        # Shared children must not expand the graph exponentially. No entry
        # slots are assigned for these helper-only layouts.
        for i in range(40):
            child = 'I' if i == 0 else 'T'+str(i-1)
            types.append(dict(name='T'+str(i),kind='struct',fields=[['a',child],['b',child]]))
        c = campaign(types,[module('root',[],['r','V']), module('helper',[['arg','T39']],['r','B']),
                            module('afilter',[],['r','B']), module('unused',[],['r','T39'])])
        c['calls'] = [['root','helper'], ['root','helper']]
        c['pipes'] = [dict(target='helper',filter='afilter',bind={})]
        c['runs'] = [dict(entry='root',ktest=ktest([]))]
        answer = execute(c)
        self.assertEqual(answer['plans'][0]['modules'], ['afilter','helper','root'])
        self.assertEqual(answer['plans'][0]['types'], ['T'+str(i) for i in range(40)])
        self.assertEqual(answer['plans'][0]['variables'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(answer['plans'][0]['flag'], None)
        self.assertEqual(answer['records'], [dict(status='READY',case=0,model_result=None)])

''' + s[pos:]
open(p,'w').write(s)

cd /workspace/project && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
